verdict.rationale: No evidence states a no-training policy or a training opt-out. LightSprint does offer indirect controls over where data flows: self-hosting in your own infrastructure, routing model traffic through your approved gateway, and bringing your own API keys or subscriptions. With these, you could keep data under provider agreements you choose, but only as a workaround. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data/code is not used for training, a documented training opt-out control, data-retention terms, and independent corroboration.
